title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1967-05-05
source: Don Wolfe's 3.75 ips > Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare 1967 set, musically beautiful and showing an early Jimi‑Hendrix influence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding version of this elusive 1967 performance, delivering crystal‑clear soundboard fidelity. Musically the show is described as gorgeous, marking a pivotal moment in the Dead’s evolution with a fresh, Hendrix‑tinged vibe throughout the set.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed five‑star review highlights both superb audio quality and an outstanding musical performance, warranting a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it the "best sounding" version, indicating clear, balanced mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised as a great, cohesive performance from a scarce era of the band's history.
